description: Two-year Treasury yield. Currently the seed-42 synthetic series; flips to FRED DGS2 at the live-market cutover.
Ten-year Treasury yield - the DCF risk-free benchmark per risk_free_policy. Synthetic until the live cutover (FRED DGS10).
Overnight policy rate. Context and scenario driver - never a direct WACC input (maturity mismatch).
Headline CPI inflation rate. NOTE: the synthetic series stores the RATE directly; the live layer ingests the CPIAUCSL index and derives YoY (auditable direction). Never plugs into WACC.
Headline unemployment. Demand/wage context for operating assumptions - never a WACC input.
Curve slope: positive = normal, near zero = flat, negative = inverted. Derived from the two tenor metrics; FRED T10Y2Y is a future cross-check only.
Personal-consumption-expenditures inflation - the Fed's preferred gauge. Synthetic series stores the rate directly; the live layer ingests the PCEPI index and derives YoY. Never a WACC input.
Output growth context for scenarios and driver rationale. The live layer ingests quarterly GDPC1 and derives YoY; monthly synthetic until then. Never a WACC input.
Investment-grade bond-market spread over Treasuries; the benchmark for the credit-spread assumption at the live cutover.
High-yield bond-market spread; risk-appetite context. Widens in stress - see the 2020 spike in the synthetic history.
Short end of the curve; tracks the policy rate closely. Synthetic until the live cutover.
Belly of the curve between the 2Y and 10Y. Synthetic until the live cutover (FRED DGS5).
Long bond; duration-sensitive end of the curve. Synthetic until the live cutover (FRED DGS30).
The recession-watch slope the news quotes most; negative = inverted. Derived from the two tenor metrics.

metric_name: Core CPI Inflation (ex food and energy)
description: Headline CPI with the volatile food/energy stripped out; the trend readers watch. Synthetic stores the rate directly.

metric_name: Core PCE Inflation (ex food and energy)
description: The Fed's 2% target is defined on this gauge. Synthetic stores the rate directly.
Pipeline inflation at the factory gate; tends to lead consumer prices with more volatility.
Wage growth from the Employment Situation report; compare against CPI for real wages.
Monthly consumer-spending pulse; the live layer ingests the dollar index and derives YoY.
Factory/mining/utilities output growth; the live layer derives YoY from the index.
Broadest slack measure: unemployed plus discouraged plus involuntary part-time. Always above U-3.
Share of the population working or looking; slow-moving denominator behind the unemployment rate.
Median weeks unemployed; rises with a lag after stress and is slow to heal.
New unemployment sign-ups; the weekly Thursday release averaged monthly here. The fastest labor stress signal.
People still drawing benefits; lags initial claims by design.
THE first-Friday headline: jobs added or lost in the month. The live layer differences the PAYEMS level.
Unfilled openings; openings-per-unemployed is the tightness ratio the Fed cites.
New residential construction starts; the most rate-sensitive activity gauge.
Household mood survey; moves with inflation and jobs headlines.
Purchasing managers survey; above 50 = expansion. Published by ISM (not redistributed via FRED) - live sourcing decision deferred to the cutover.
Dollars per troy ounce; the classic stress hedge - note the bid when unemployment spikes. FRED discontinued its LBMA series; live source chosen at cutover (LBMA or a licensed feed).
Dollars per troy ounce; tracks gold at a ratio near 70:1. Live source chosen at cutover.
Dollars per barrel; demand-driven - watch the 2020 collapse and the inflation-era recovery. Flips to FRED DCOILWTICO at cutover.
Dollars per pound at retail; compounds with CPI - a grocery-aisle view of inflation. Flips to FRED APU0000703112 at cutover.
Synthetic tech-sector index; rate-sensitive (drawdowns when yields rise). Live proxy at cutover: NASDAQ Composite (FRED NASDAQCOM).
Synthetic AI-theme basket that steepens late-sample. No standard public series exists - the owner defines constituents and source at cutover.
